recentItems.title: TOTAL BLOCKADE OF RUSSIA: Finland's iron curtain and drone pressure in the Black Sea
recentItems.description:
The war in Ukraine, demands on Russia, EU sanctions, and drone attacks in the Black Sea are the main topics of this afternoon news edition.

47 nations and the European Union have called on Russia to end its aggression and immediately withdraw its troops and equipment from the entire territory of Ukraine. Following a conversation with Merz, Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that Germany is preparing a meeting of the "coalition of the willing." Meanwhile, Finland is urging the EU to stop issuing Schengen tourist visas to Russians until the war of aggression ends.

Off the coast of Bulgaria, drones attacked two merchant vessels, one of which sank. Watch the full video for details on international statements and developments in the Black Sea.

recentItems.title: DISASTER FOR RUSSIA: Digital blackout, burning refineries, and shocking monthly troop losses!
recentItems.description:
Strikes on Yandex data centers and Russian oil refineries, Russian army losses, and Russian diesel in the US — key topics on News Pulse with Anita Morhun. In this episode: reports of outages across more than 80 digital services, attacks on oil facilities in Samara, Omsk, and Ukhta, and hits on Russian military logistics. According to Bloomberg, citing a NATO official, Russia lost approximately 50,000 troops in September. US senators demand revoking the diesel import permit, while Germany maintains its sanctions stance. We analyze Zelenskyy's response to Trump and Musk, Finland's visa initiative for Russians, and EU support for Ukraine. Watch the full news roundup.

recentItems.title: RUSSIA IS BURNING: From Omsk to Komi! Air defense breached, Yandex goes down
recentItems.description:
Strikes on Russian oil refineries and the Yandex data center: Ukrainian drones are attacking Russia's rear, and Russian air defense cannot handle the workload. In this episode — fires at oil refineries in Omsk and Komi, disruptions to Yandex services following the attack in Sasovo, and the consequences for Russia's economy and army. Military analyst Dmytro Sniehyrov analyzes attack tactics, the capabilities of the FP-5 "Flamingo" and FP-9 missiles, fuel shortages, and the growth of the occupiers' losses. Is Russia threatened by a new wave of mobilization? How do infrastructure attacks affect the Kremlin's ability to wage war, and why is Putin seeking Trump's support?

recentItems.description:
Ukrainian drones, a strike on a rocket fuel plant, and forced mobilization in Russia — in this episode of No Filters. We break down the attack on a chemical complex in Tver region supplying fuel components for Kh-55 and Kh-101 missiles. Why is the Kremlin demanding the extradition of International Criminal Court President Tomoko Akane, and how are US sanctions increasing pressure on the court? In Nizhny Tagil, military recruitment turns into a business of kidnappings and beatings. We analyze statements by Peskov and Rubio on negotiations, accusations against Ukraine, and the role of military support and economic pressure on Moscow.

recentItems.title: Digital Stone Age for Russia: Ukraine burns the "brain" of Russian Google
recentItems.description:
Strikes on Yandex data centers, Ukrainian drones, and failures of Russian services — on Frontline Focus with Operator Starsky. This episode covers attacks in Sasovo, Kaluga, and Vladimir region, along with disruptions in cloud storage, online payments, taxi services, and banking platforms. We analyze the fire at an oil depot near Moscow and strikes on oil refineries in Omsk and Ukhta. Trump announced an energy truce, but Russia continues to attack Ukraine. Zelenskyy declares readiness to stop strikes on oil refineries on the condition that attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure cease.
